notes_for_editor: Two county lists (Koochiching PDF and the A-Z list) agree on 1952 and 80 feet; the 'Removed' wording appears only in the Koochiching PDF. The Rapid River origin is the county list's own guess and is told as a guess. The FFLA list gives no date. No photos, staffing or fire sources were found in two searches; the story leaves those out. Access is marked private per the county list, so the story gives no visit advice.
